digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics surface and agent skill integration
propositions: rebar-janitor Discovery phase needs to consult `rebar metrics --since/--until --output json` and cite code-health lens values (module-size distribution, oversized-module count, module-size trend, churn, refactor-to-addition ratio, cap-change events) as historical evidence
agents and contributors cannot discover or understand rebar metrics without documentation and cross-references in the project's canonical docs and agent guidance
the metrics surface requires explicit handling of the `unavailable` state (signal not yet accrued) so agents do not conflate absence with zero
discovery.md must instruct subagents that rebar metrics are the durable trend complement to one-shot tools like cloc/tokei/ast-grep, not a replacement
user-guide.md must document the four metric lenses, source/confidence labels, and unavailable state as the human-discoverable home for metrics
docs/reuse-surface.md and AGENTS.md must reference the reusable rebar.metrics subsystem (MetricSpec, REGISTRY) and user-guide.md so library consumers and agents find it
